collections.name: The Autumn Edit

merchants.name: ABC Electronics
merchants.tagline: Computing, audio and everyday tech that lasts
merchants.about: ABC Electronics has supplied Lagos with dependable hardware since 2023. Every unit is bench-tested before it ships, and the support line is answered by the people who pack the boxes.

merchants.name: AuraSound Audio
merchants.tagline: Tuned by ear in Cape Town
merchants.about: AuraSound builds audio for people who listen closely. Drivers are measured in-house and every model is tuned against a reference pair before release.

merchants.name: Nova Fashion
merchants.tagline: Quiet tailoring, made to be worn
merchants.about: Nova Fashion cuts small runs in Accra. Natural fibres, generous seams and a repair service on everything they sell.

merchants.name: Sahel Supply
merchants.about: Sahel Supply works directly with growers across the Sahel. Single-origin lots, cold-pressed oils and spice blends milled to order.

merchants.name: Lumen Home
merchants.about: Lumen Home makes domestic objects in Nairobi with a long life in mind. Replaceable parts, honest materials, no seasonal churn.

merchants.name: PixelForge Gaming
merchants.about: PixelForge tests every switch, sensor and panel before it goes on sale. Built for people who notice the difference.

merchants.name: Verdant Beauty
merchants.about: Verdant Beauty formulates in Abuja with clinically studied actives and no filler. Batch dates are printed on every bottle.

merchants.name: Ferixas Official Store
merchants.tagline: Sold by the platform, on the same terms as everyone else
merchants.about: The platform sells its own hardware through exactly the same catalogue, the same channels and the same checkout as every other tenant. Nothing special-cased, nothing privileged.
